snippet.title: The Wandering — Trailer
snippet.description:
The Wandering is a narrative-driven single-player first-person experience set in a labyrinth with no exit in sight. Trapped with five other people, you can use ANY dialogue you want from ANY conversation you like to answer the game's questions and escape!

► Available for Windows & Mac @
■ https://luisleon.itch.io/the-wandering

■ The Wandering is a short adventure game that can be completed in approximately 2-4 hours (or more! depends entirely on you!)
■ The game features a save system so you can play in more than one session.
■ The game's currently available only in English. Spanish translation may come later down the line.


► Developed by Team Wanderer
■ Luis León - Game & level design, writing, UI and programming
■ Yael Enríquez  - 3D Art and texturing

This game was developed as a thesis for a Game Design Degree. While the project may include some unpolished features, the project's "finished" as it stands. We would love to read your comments and feedback!
